import enrolment = "./enrolment.qui"
import conflict_graph = "./conflict_graph.qui"
import rooms = "./rooms.qui"

class Order(int later, int earlier)

class Context(enrolment.Course[] courses, rooms.Room[] available, conflict_graph.Graph graph, int slots)
    allowed := array(nat(int(#courses) * (slots + 1)), fill = false)
    fixed := array(#courses, fill = 0)
    int[] open := []
    Order[] orders := []

    bool suitable(int course, int slot)
        return allowed[course * (slots + 1) + slot]

    int[] at_slot(int[] assignment, int slot)
        int[] result := []
        for: c < int(#courses)
            if assignment[c] == slot
                result = result.append(c)
        return result

    bool packs(int[] selected)
        return rooms.pack(available, courses, selected).success

    int[] order_conflicts(int course, int slot, int[] assignment)
        int[] result := []
        for order := orders[]
            if order.later == course and assignment[order.earlier] > 0 and slot <= assignment[order.earlier]
                result = result.append(order.earlier)
            elif order.earlier == course and assignment[order.later] > 0 and slot >= assignment[order.later]
                result = result.append(order.later)
        return result.sorted()

    bool orders_satisfied(int[] assignment)
        for order := orders[]
            if assignment[order.later] > 0 and assignment[order.earlier] > 0 and assignment[order.later] <= assignment[order.earlier]
                return false
        return true

    int[] candidates(int course, int[] assignment)
        int[] result := []
        for slot := open[]
            if not suitable(course, slot)
                continue
            clash := false
            for other := graph.vertices[]
                if graph.strength(course, other) > 0 and assignment[other] == slot
                    clash = true
            if clash or #order_conflicts(course, slot, assignment) > 0
                continue
            if packs(at_slot(assignment, slot).append(course))
                result = result.append(slot)
        return result

class Choice(int course, int saturation)

class Attempt(Context context, int[] pending, int limit)
    dead_ends := 0
    failed := -1
    aborted := false
    Choice[] chosen := []
    int[] assignment := context.fixed

    int saturation(int course)
        int[] used := []
        for other := context.graph.vertices[]
            slot := assignment[other]
            if context.graph.strength(course, other) > 0 and slot > 0 and not enrolment.has_int(used, slot)
                used = used.append(slot)
        return int(#used)

    bool .search()
        course := -1
        best_saturation := -1
        for c := pending[]
            if assignment[c] > 0
                continue
            int sat := saturation(c)
            if course < 0 or sat > best_saturation or (sat == best_saturation and context.graph.degrees[c] > context.graph.degrees[course]) or (sat == best_saturation and context.graph.degrees[c] == context.graph.degrees[course] and c < course)
                course = c
                best_saturation = sat
        if course < 0
            return true
        chosen = chosen.append(Choice(course, best_saturation))
        for slot := context.candidates(course, assignment)[]
            assignment[course] = slot
            if .search()
                return true
            assignment[course] = 0
            if aborted
                return false
        chosen = chosen[0:<#chosen - 1]
        dead_ends += 1
        failed = course
        aborted = dead_ends > limit
        return false

int greedy_numbering(int[] order, conflict_graph.Graph graph)
    numbers := array(nat(graph.count), fill = 0)
    largest := 0
    for c := order[]
        int[] taken := []
        for other := graph.vertices[]
            if graph.strength(c, other) > 0 and numbers[other] > 0
                taken = taken.append(numbers[other])
        number := 1
        while enrolment.has_int(taken, number)
            number += 1
        numbers[c] = number
        if number > largest
            largest = number
    return largest

class Graph(enrolment.Course[] courses, local enrolment.Student[] students)
    count := int(#courses)
    shared := array(nat(count * count), fill = 0)
    int[] vertices := []
    degrees := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for: c < count
        if #courses[c].students > 0
            vertices = vertices.append(c)
    for student := students[]
        for: i < int(#student.courses)
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#student.courses)
                a := student.courses[i]
                b := student.courses[j]
                shared[a * count + b] += 1
                shared[b * count + a] += 1
    for: a < count
        for: b < count
            if shared[a * count + b] > 0
                degrees[a] += 1

    int strength(int a, int b)
        return shared[a * count + b]

    int shared_total(int c)
        total := 0
        for: other < count
            total += strength(c, other)
        return total

    int[] by_degree(int[] selected)
        int[] result := []
        for c := selected[]
            position := int(#result)
            result = result.append(c)
            while position > 0
                previous := result[position - 1]
                if degrees[previous] > degrees[c] or (degrees[previous] == degrees[c] and previous < c)
                    break
                result[position] = previous
                position -= 1
            result[position] = c
        return result

    int[][] components()
        seen := array(nat(count), fill = false)
        int[][] result := []
        for start := vertices[]
            if seen[start]
                continue
            group := [start]
            seen[start] = true
            position := 0
            while position < int(#group)
                for other := vertices[]
                    if strength(group[position], other) > 0 and not seen[other]
                        seen[other] = true
                        group = group.append(other)
                position += 1
            group = group.sorted()
            at := int(#result)
            result = result.append(group)
            while at > 0
                previous := result[at - 1]
                if #previous > #group or (#previous == #group and previous[0] < group[0])
                    break
                result[at] = previous
                at -= 1
            result[at] = group
        return result

    int[] clique(int[] candidates)
        int[] result := []
        while #candidates != 0
            int chosen := by_degree(candidates)[0]
            result = result.append(chosen)
            int[] next := []
            for c := candidates[]
                if strength(chosen, c) > 0
                    next = next.append(c)
            candidates = next
        return result

    int[] chain(int[] assignment, int start, int home, int target)
        result := [start]
        seen := array(nat(count), fill = false)
        seen[start] = true
        position := 0
        while position < int(#result)
            for other := vertices[]
                if not seen[other] and strength(result[position], other) > 0 and (assignment[other] == home or assignment[other] == target)
                    seen[other] = true
                    result = result.append(other)
            position += 1
        return result.sorted()

bool reachable(int[] arrows, int count, int source, int target)
    queue := [source]
    seen := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    seen[source] = true
    position := 0
    while position < int(#queue)
        current := queue[position]
        if current == target
            return true
        for: next < count
            if arrows[current * count + next] > 0 and not seen[next]
                seen[next] = true
                queue = queue.append(next)
        position += 1
    return false

class Course(string id, int duration, string name)
    string[] students := []

class Student(string id)
    int[] courses := []

class Dataset()
    Course[] courses := []
    Student[] students := []
    string[] errors := []
    accepted := 0

string[] read_lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := text.split(NL)
    if #lines > 0 and lines[-1] == ""
        lines = lines[0:<#lines - 1]
    return lines

int course_index(Course[] courses, string id)
    for: i < int(#courses)
        if courses[i].id == id
            return i
    return -1

int student_index(Student[] students, string id)
    for: i < int(#students)
        if students[i].id == id
            return i
    return -1

bool has_string(string[] values, string value)
    for item := values[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

bool has_int(int[] values, int value)
    for item := values[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

Dataset load()
    data := Dataset()
    lines := read_lines("input/courses.csv")
    for: 1 <= i < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[i].split(",")
        id := fields[0]
        if course_index(data.courses, id) >= 0
            data.errors = data.errors.append("courses.csv line {i + 1}: duplicate course {id}")
        else
            data.courses = data.courses.append(Course(id, int(fields[1]), fields[2]))
    string[] ids := []
    for course := data.courses[]
        ids = ids.append(course.id)
    Course[] ordered := []
    for id := ids.sorted()[]
        ordered = ordered.append(data.courses[course_index(data.courses, id)])
    data.courses = ordered
    lines = read_lines("input/enrolments.csv")
    for: 1 <= i < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[i].split(",")
        student := fields[0]
        id := fields[1]
        c := course_index(data.courses, id)
        if c < 0
            data.errors = data.errors.append("enrolments.csv line {i + 1}: unknown course {id}")
        elif has_string(data.courses[c].students, student)
            data.errors = data.errors.append("enrolments.csv line {i + 1}: duplicate enrolment {student} {id}")
        else
            data.courses[c].students = data.courses[c].students.append(student)
            s := student_index(data.students, student)
            if s < 0
                s = int(#data.students)
                data.students = data.students.append(Student(student))
            data.students[s].courses = data.students[s].courses.append(c)
            data.accepted += 1
    for: c < int(#data.courses)
        data.courses[c].students = data.courses[c].students.sorted()
    ids = []
    for student := data.students[]
        ids = ids.append(student.id)
    Student[] students := []
    for id := ids.sorted()[]
        student := data.students[student_index(data.students, id)]
        student.courses = student.courses.sorted()
        students = students.append(student)
    data.students = students
    return data

import enrolment = "./enrolment.qui"
import conflict_graph = "./conflict_graph.qui"
import coloring = "./coloring.qui"
import rooms = "./rooms.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

int[] integers(string line)
    fields := line.split(" ")
    int[] result := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#fields)
        result = result.append(int(fields[i]))
    return result

int smaller(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int ceil_div(int a, int b)
    return (a + b - 1) / b

int get_count(map<int, int> counts, int key)
    match counts.get(key)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return 0

void increment(map<int, int> &counts, int key)
    .counts.set(key, get_count(counts, key) + 1)

class Calendar(local string[] lines, local int student_count)
    int days := integers(lines[0])[0]
    int[] lengths := integers(lines[1])
    periods := int(#lengths)
    int limit := integers(lines[2])[0]
    int[] weights := integers(lines[3])
    int front_count := integers(lines[4])[0]
    int deadline := integers(lines[4])[1]
    int ratio := integers(lines[5])[0]
    slots := days * periods
    closed := array(nat(slots + 1), fill = false)
    unavailable := array(nat(student_count * (slots + 1)), fill = false)

    int slot_at(string day_text, string period_text)
        day := int(day_text)
        period := int(period_text)
        if day < 1 or day > days or period < 1 or period > periods
            return 0
        return (day - 1) * periods + period

    int day_of(int slot)
        return (slot - 1) / periods + 1

    string name(int slot)
        return "D{day_of(slot)}P{(slot - 1) % periods + 1}"

    int length(int slot)
        return lengths[(slot - 1) % periods]

    bool blocked(int student, int slot)
        return unavailable[student * (slots + 1) + slot]

    int relation(int first, int second)
        low := smaller(first, second)
        high := if first > second then first else second
        if day_of(low) == day_of(high)
            if high - low == 1
                return 0
            if high - low >= 2
                return 1
        elif high - low == 1
            return 2
        return -1

class Breakdown(int[] counts, int late, local int[] weights)
    int total := counts[0] * weights[0] + counts[1] * weights[1] + counts[2] * weights[2] + late * weights[3]

    string text()
        return "back_to_back {counts[0]} same_day {counts[1]} overnight {counts[2]} front_load {late} penalty {total}"

class PenaltyPair(int first, int second, int relation, int strength)
class AttemptRecord(int count, int dead_ends, int failed)
class AssignmentRecord(int course, int slot, int saturation)
class Insertion(int course, int slot, int increase)
class Trial(int verdict, int[] assignment, int[] chain, int penalty)
class StudentResult(int[] assigned, int[] counts, int penalty)

class Scheduler(enrolment.Dataset data, rooms.Room[] available, Calendar calendar)
    graph := conflict_graph.Graph(data.courses, data.students)
    context := coloring.Context(data.courses, available, graph, calendar.slots)
    int largest_room := available[-1].capacity
    int[] empty := []
    int[] oversized := []
    int[] schedulable := []
    for: c < int(#data.courses)
        enrolment_count := int(#data.courses[c].students)
        if enrolment_count == 0
            empty = empty.append(c)
        elif enrolment_count > largest_room
            oversized = oversized.append(c)
        else
            schedulable = schedulable.append(c)
    local ranked := rooms.by_size(data.courses, schedulable)
    int[] front_load := ranked[0:<smaller(calendar.front_count, int(#ranked))]
    arrows := array(nat(graph.count * graph.count), fill = 0)
    int[] assignment := context.fixed
    int[] excluded := []
    AttemptRecord[] attempts := []
    AssignmentRecord[] assignment_order := []
    Insertion[] insertions := []
    string[][] reasons := array(nat(graph.count), fill = [])
    initial := Breakdown([0, 0, 0], 0, calendar.weights)
    exchanged := initial
    penalty := 0
    string[] exchange_log := []
    string[] swap_log := []
    rooms.Placement[][] slot_placements := array(nat(calendar.slots + 1), fill = [])
    rooms.Placement[] placements := array(nat(graph.count), fill = rooms.Placement(-1, -1, 0, 0))

    string id(int course)
        return data.courses[course].id

    int size(int course)
        return int(#data.courses[course].students)

    string[] blocked_students(int course, int slot)
        string[] result := []
        for student := data.courses[course].students[]
            s := enrolment.student_index(data.students, student)
            if calendar.blocked(s, slot)
                result = result.append(student)
        return result

    bool suitable(int course, int slot)
        return calendar.length(slot) >= data.courses[course].duration and #blocked_students(course, slot) == 0

    string outside(string day, string period)
        return "slot {day} {period} outside calendar"

    string .accept_closed(string[] fields)
        slot := calendar.slot_at(fields[1], fields[2])
        if slot == 0
            return outside(fields[1], fields[2])
        if calendar.closed[slot]
            return "duplicate closed {calendar.name(slot)}"
        calendar.closed[slot] = true
        return ""

    string .accept_unavailable(string[] fields)
        student := fields[1]
        s := enrolment.student_index(data.students, student)
        if s < 0
            return "unknown student {student}"
        slot := calendar.slot_at(fields[2], fields[3])
        if slot == 0
            return outside(fields[2], fields[3])
        if calendar.blocked(s, slot)
            return "duplicate unavailable {student} {calendar.name(slot)}"
        calendar.unavailable[s * (calendar.slots + 1) + slot] = true
        return ""

    string .accept_fixed(string[] fields)
        c := enrolment.course_index(data.courses, fields[1])
        if c < 0
            return "unknown course {fields[1]}"
        if not enrolment.has_int(schedulable, c)
            return "course {id(c)} not schedulable"
        slot := calendar.slot_at(fields[2], fields[3])
        if slot == 0
            return outside(fields[2], fields[3])
        if calendar.closed[slot]
            return "slot {calendar.name(slot)} closed"
        if not suitable(c, slot)
            return "slot {calendar.name(slot)} unsuitable for {id(c)}"
        if context.fixed[c] > 0
            return "duplicate fixed {id(c)}"
        int[] group := context.at_slot(context.fixed, slot)
        for other := group[]
            if graph.strength(c, other) > 0
                return "conflict {id(c)} {id(other)}"
        if not context.packs(group.append(c))
            return "rooms full {calendar.name(slot)}"
        context.fixed[c] = slot
        return ""

    string .accept_after(string[] fields)
        a := enrolment.course_index(data.courses, fields[1])
        b := enrolment.course_index(data.courses, fields[2])
        if a < 0
            return "unknown course {fields[1]}"
        if b < 0
            return "unknown course {fields[2]}"
        if not enrolment.has_int(schedulable, a)
            return "course {id(a)} not schedulable"
        if not enrolment.has_int(schedulable, b)
            return "course {id(b)} not schedulable"
        if a == b
            return "bad order {id(a)} {id(b)}"
        if arrows[a * graph.count + b] > 0
            return "duplicate order {id(a)} {id(b)}"
        if conflict_graph.reachable(arrows, graph.count, b, a)
            return "cycle {id(a)} {id(b)}"
        if context.fixed[a] > 0 and context.fixed[b] > 0 and context.fixed[a] <= context.fixed[b]
            return "fixed order {id(a)} {id(b)}"
        context.orders = context.orders.append(coloring.Order(a, b))
        arrows[a * graph.count + b] = 1
        return ""

    void .validate_calendar(string[] lines)
        for: 6 <= i < int(#lines)
            fields := lines[i].split(" ")
            message := ""
            if fields[0] == "closed"
                message = .accept_closed(fields)
            elif fields[0] == "unavailable"
                message = .accept_unavailable(fields)
            elif fields[0] == "fixed"
                message = .accept_fixed(fields)
            else
                message = .accept_after(fields)
            if message != ""
                data.errors = data.errors.append("calendar.txt line {i + 1}: {message}")
        for: 1 <= slot <= calendar.slots
            if not calendar.closed[slot]
                context.open = context.open.append(slot)
            for: int c < graph.count
                context.allowed[c * (calendar.slots + 1) + slot] = suitable(c, slot)

    void .build_timetable()
        while true
            int[] pending := []
            for c := schedulable[]
                if context.fixed[c] == 0 and not enrolment.has_int(excluded, c)
                    pending = pending.append(c)
            attempt := coloring.Attempt(context, pending, calendar.limit)
            success := .attempt.search()
            failed := if success then -1 else attempt.failed
            attempts = attempts.append(AttemptRecord(int(#pending), attempt.dead_ends, failed))
            if success
                assignment = attempt.assignment
                for choice := attempt.chosen[]
                    assignment_order = assignment_order.append(AssignmentRecord(choice.course, assignment[choice.course], choice.saturation))
                return
            excluded = excluded.append(failed)

    int[] assigned_courses()
        int[] result := []
        for: int c < graph.count
            if assignment[c] > 0
                result = result.append(c)
        return result

    int[] unscheduled()
        int[] result := []
        for c := graph.vertices[]
            if assignment[c] == 0
                result = result.append(c)
        return result

    PenaltyPair[] penalty_pairs(int[] timetable)
        PenaltyPair[] result := []
        for a := graph.vertices[]
            for b := graph.vertices[]
                if a >= b or timetable[a] == 0 or timetable[b] == 0
                    continue
                int shared := graph.strength(a, b)
                relation := calendar.relation(timetable[a], timetable[b])
                if shared > 0 and relation >= 0
                    result = result.append(PenaltyPair(a, b, relation, shared))
        return result

    int[] late_courses(int[] timetable)
        int[] result := []
        for c := front_load[]
            if timetable[c] > calendar.deadline
                result = result.append(c)
        return result

    Breakdown breakdown(int[] timetable)
        counts := [0, 0, 0]
        for pair := penalty_pairs(timetable)[]
            counts[pair.relation] += pair.strength
        return Breakdown(counts, int(#late_courses(timetable)), calendar.weights)

    int[] contributions()
        result := array(nat(graph.count), fill = 0)
        for pair := penalty_pairs(assignment)[]
            int value := calendar.weights[pair.relation] * pair.strength
            result[pair.first] += value
            result[pair.second] += value
        for c := late_courses(assignment)[]
            result[c] += calendar.weights[3]
        return result

    string blocking_reason(int course, int slot)
        if calendar.closed[slot]
            return "closed"
        if calendar.length(slot) < data.courses[course].duration
            return "too_short"
        string[] blocked := blocked_students(course, slot)
        if #blocked > 0
            return "unavailable {blocked[0]}"
        clash := -1
        shared := 0
        for other := graph.vertices[]
            int strength := graph.strength(course, other)
            if assignment[other] == slot and strength > shared
                clash = other
                shared = strength
        if clash >= 0
            return "conflict {id(clash)} shared {shared}"
        int[] conflicts := context.order_conflicts(course, slot, assignment)
        if #conflicts > 0
            return "order {id(conflicts[0])}"
        return "rooms"

    void .insert_excluded()
        for course := excluded.sorted()[]
            int[] candidates := context.candidates(course, assignment)
            if #candidates == 0
                for: 1 <= slot <= calendar.slots
                    reasons[course] = reasons[course].append(blocking_reason(course, slot))
                continue
            int before := breakdown(assignment).total
            best := 0
            best_penalty := 0
            for slot := candidates[]
                trial := assignment
                trial[course] = slot
                int total := breakdown(trial).total
                if best == 0 or total < best_penalty
                    best = slot
                    best_penalty = total
            assignment[course] = best
            insertions = insertions.append(Insertion(course, best, best_penalty - before))
        initial = breakdown(assignment)
        penalty = initial.total

    bool valid_trial(int[] trial, int[] moved)
        for c := moved[]
            if not context.suitable(c, trial[c])
                return false
        return context.orders_satisfied(trial)

    Trial exchange_trial(int home, int target)
        for fixed := context.fixed[]
            if fixed == home or fixed == target
                return Trial(0, [], [], 0)
        trial := assignment
        int[] moved := []
        for c := assigned_courses()[]
            if assignment[c] == home or assignment[c] == target
                trial[c] = if assignment[c] == home then target else home
                moved = moved.append(c)
        if not valid_trial(trial, moved)
            return Trial(1, [], [], 0)
        int total := breakdown(trial).total
        if total >= penalty
            return Trial(2, [], [], 0)
        return Trial(3, trial, moved, total)

    void .exchange_slots()
        round := 0
        serial := 0
        while true
            round += 1
            tally := [0, 0, 0, 0]
            string[] records := []
            pairs := 0
            for: i < int(#context.open)
                int home := context.open[i]
                for: i + 1 <= j < int(#context.open)
                    int target := context.open[j]
                    pairs += 1
                    Trial trial := exchange_trial(home, target)
                    tally[trial.verdict] += 1
                    if trial.verdict == 3
                        serial += 1
                        records = records.append("EXCHANGE {serial} {calendar.name(home)} {calendar.name(target)} penalty {penalty} -> {trial.penalty}")
                        assignment = trial.assignment
                        penalty = trial.penalty
            exchange_log = exchange_log.append("ROUND {round} pairs {pairs} fixed {tally[0]} invalid {tally[1]} worse {tally[2]} applied {tally[3]}")
            exchange_log = exchange_log.concat(records)
            if tally[3] == 0
                break
        exchanged = breakdown(assignment)

    Trial swap_trial(int course, int home, int target)
        int[] chain := graph.chain(assignment, course, home, target)
        for member := chain[]
            if context.fixed[member] > 0
                return Trial(0, [], [], 0)
        trial := assignment
        for member := chain[]
            trial[member] = if assignment[member] == home then target else home
        if not valid_trial(trial, chain)
            return Trial(1, [], [], 0)
        if not context.packs(context.at_slot(trial, home)) or not context.packs(context.at_slot(trial, target))
            return Trial(2, [], [], 0)
        int total := breakdown(trial).total
        if total >= penalty
            return Trial(3, [], [], 0)
        return Trial(4, trial, chain, total)

    void .swap_chains()
        pass_number := 0
        serial := 0
        while true
            pass_number += 1
            tally := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
            candidates := 0
            string[] records := []
            for course := assigned_courses()[]
                if context.fixed[course] > 0
                    continue
                home := assignment[course]
                for target := context.open[]
                    if target == home
                        continue
                    candidates += 1
                    Trial trial := swap_trial(course, home, target)
                    tally[trial.verdict] += 1
                    if trial.verdict != 4
                        continue
                    serial += 1
                    records = records.append("SWAP {serial} {id(course)} {calendar.name(home)} {calendar.name(target)} chain {#trial.chain} penalty {penalty} -> {trial.penalty}")
                    for member := trial.chain[]
                        records = records.append("  MOVE {id(member)} {calendar.name(assignment[member])} -> {calendar.name(trial.assignment[member])}")
                    assignment = trial.assignment
                    penalty = trial.penalty
                    break
            swap_log = swap_log.append("PASS {pass_number} candidates {candidates} fixed {tally[0]} invalid {tally[1]} rooms {tally[2]} worse {tally[3]} applied {tally[4]}")
            swap_log = swap_log.concat(records)
            if tally[4] == 0
                break

    void .assign_rooms()
        for slot := context.open[]
            packed := rooms.pack(available, data.courses, context.at_slot(assignment, slot))
            slot_placements[slot] = packed.placements
            for placement := packed.placements[]
                placements[placement.course] = placement

    int[] room_loads(int slot)
        result := array(#available, fill = 0)
        for placement := slot_placements[slot][]
            result[placement.room] += size(placement.course)
        return result

    int invigilators(int slot)
        result := 0
        for load := room_loads(slot)[]
            result += ceil_div(load, calendar.ratio)
        return result

    int slot_students(int slot)
        result := 0
        for course := context.at_slot(assignment, slot)[]
            result += size(course)
        return result

    StudentResult student_result(int student)
        int[] assigned := []
        for course := data.students[student].courses[]
            if assignment[course] == 0
                continue
            position := int(#assigned)
            assigned = assigned.append(course)
            while position > 0 and assignment[assigned[position - 1]] > assignment[course]
                assigned[position] = assigned[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            assigned[position] = course
        counts := [0, 0, 0]
        for: i < int(#assigned)
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#assigned)
                relation := calendar.relation(assignment[assigned[i]], assignment[assigned[j]])
                if relation >= 0
                    counts[relation] += 1
        total := counts[0] * calendar.weights[0] + counts[1] * calendar.weights[1] + counts[2] * calendar.weights[2]
        return StudentResult(assigned, counts, total)

    string[] timetable_lines()
        lines := ["TIMETABLE days {calendar.days} periods {calendar.periods} open {#context.open} courses {graph.count} scheduled {#assigned_courses()} unscheduled {#unscheduled()} empty {#empty}"]
        string[] header := []
        for: 1 <= period <= calendar.periods
            header = header.append("P{period}")
        header = header.append("TOTAL")
        lines = lines.append(report.fixed_width_line("DAY", header, 4, 10))
        for: 1 <= day <= calendar.days
            string[] cells := []
            exams := 0
            students := 0
            for: 1 <= period <= calendar.periods
                slot := (day - 1) * calendar.periods + period
                if calendar.closed[slot]
                    cells = cells.append("closed")
                else
                    count := int(#context.at_slot(assignment, slot))
                    int load := slot_students(slot)
                    cells = cells.append("{count}/{load}")
                    exams += count
                    students += load
            cells = cells.append("{exams}/{students}")
            lines = lines.append(report.fixed_width_line("D{day}", cells, 4, 10))
        for: 1 <= slot <= calendar.slots
            prefix := "SLOT {slot} {calendar.name(slot)} minutes {calendar.length(slot)}"
            if calendar.closed[slot]
                lines = lines.append(prefix + " closed")
                continue
            int[] loads := room_loads(slot)
            used := 0
            seats := 0
            for: r < int(#available)
                if loads[r] > 0
                    used += 1
                    seats += available[r].capacity
            lines = lines.append(prefix + " exams {#slot_placements[slot]} students {slot_students(slot)} rooms {used} seats {seats} invigilators {invigilators(slot)}")
            for placement := slot_placements[slot][]
                c := placement.course
                marker := if context.fixed[c] > 0 then " fixed" else ""
                lines = lines.append("  {id(c)} {data.courses[c].duration}min students {size(c)} room {available[placement.room].id} seats {placement.first}-{placement.last}{marker} {data.courses[c].name}")
        for: r < int(#available)
            slots_used := 0
            exams := 0
            seated := 0
            for slot := context.open[]
                used := false
                for placement := slot_placements[slot][]
                    if placement.room == r
                        used = true
                        exams += 1
                        seated += size(placement.course)
                if used
                    slots_used += 1
            utilization := report.rounded_percent(seated, available[r].capacity * int(#context.open))
            lines = lines.append("ROOM {available[r].id} capacity {available[r].capacity} slots {slots_used} exams {exams} seated {seated} utilization {utilization}")
        total := 0
        for slot := context.open[]
            total += invigilators(slot)
        lines = lines.append("INVIGILATORS total {total} ratio {calendar.ratio}")
        return lines

    string[] room_lines()
        lines := ["slot,room,course,students,first_seat,last_seat"]
        for slot := context.open[]
            for: r < int(#available)
                for placement := slot_placements[slot][]
                    if placement.room == r
                        c := placement.course
                        lines = lines.append("{calendar.name(slot)},{available[r].id},{id(c)},{size(c)},{placement.first},{placement.last}")
        return lines

    string[] student_statistics()
        map<int, int> histogram
        map<int, int> gaps
        map<int, int> day_loads
        int[] ranked_students := []
        int[] penalties := []
        int[][] relation_counts := []
        for: student < int(#data.students)
            StudentResult result := student_result(student)
            penalties = penalties.append(result.penalty)
            relation_counts = relation_counts.append(result.counts)
            increment(&histogram, result.penalty)
            daily := array(nat(calendar.days + 1), fill = 0)
            maximum := 0
            for: i < int(#result.assigned)
                slot := assignment[result.assigned[i]]
                if i > 0
                    increment(&gaps, slot - assignment[result.assigned[i - 1]])
                day := calendar.day_of(slot)
                daily[day] += 1
                if daily[day] > maximum
                    maximum = daily[day]
            if maximum > 0
                increment(&day_loads, maximum)
            position := int(#ranked_students)
            ranked_students = ranked_students.append(student)
            while position > 0 and penalties[ranked_students[position - 1]] < result.penalty
                ranked_students[position] = ranked_students[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            ranked_students[position] = student
        string[] lines := []
        for value := histogram.keys().sorted()[]
            lines = lines.append("HISTOGRAM {value} {get_count(histogram, value)}")
        for value := gaps.keys().sorted()[]
            lines = lines.append("GAP {value} {get_count(gaps, value)}")
        for value := day_loads.keys().sorted()[]
            lines = lines.append("DAYLOAD {value} {get_count(day_loads, value)}")
        for: i < smaller(5, int(#ranked_students))
            student := ranked_students[i]
            if penalties[student] > 0
                counts := relation_counts[student]
                lines = lines.append("WORST {data.students[student].id} penalty {penalties[student]} back_to_back {counts[0]} same_day {counts[1]} overnight {counts[2]}")
        return lines

    string[] penalty_lines()
        weights := calendar.weights
        lines := ["WEIGHTS back_to_back {weights[0]} same_day {weights[1]} overnight {weights[2]} front_load {weights[3]}", "FRONT_LOAD courses {#front_load} last_slot {calendar.name(calendar.deadline)}", "INITIAL {initial.text()}"]
        lines = lines.concat(exchange_log)
        lines = lines.append("EXCHANGED {exchanged.text()}")
        lines = lines.concat(swap_log)
        Breakdown final := breakdown(assignment)
        lines = lines.append("FINAL {final.text()}")
        lines = lines.append("SAVED {initial.total - final.total}")
        int[][] daily := array(nat(calendar.days + 1), fill = [0, 0, 0])
        for pair := penalty_pairs(assignment)[]
            day := calendar.day_of(smaller(assignment[pair.first], assignment[pair.second]))
            daily[day][pair.relation] += pair.strength
        for: 1 <= day <= calendar.days
            counts := daily[day]
            lines = lines.append("DAY D{day} back_to_back {counts[0]} same_day {counts[1]} overnight {counts[2]}")
        for course := late_courses(assignment)[]
            lines = lines.append("LATE {id(course)} {calendar.name(assignment[course])} students {size(course)}")
        int[] values := contributions()
        int[] ranked_courses := []
        for course := assigned_courses()[]
            position := int(#ranked_courses)
            ranked_courses = ranked_courses.append(course)
            while position > 0 and values[ranked_courses[position - 1]] < values[course]
                ranked_courses[position] = ranked_courses[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            ranked_courses[position] = course
        for: i < smaller(10, int(#ranked_courses))
            course := ranked_courses[i]
            if values[course] > 0
                lines = lines.append("COURSE {id(course)} {calendar.name(assignment[course])} penalty {values[course]}")
        return lines.concat(student_statistics())

    string[] schedule_lines(string[] queries)
        relations := ["BACK_TO_BACK", "SAME_DAY", "OVERNIGHT"]
        string[] lines := []
        for student_id := queries[]
            student := enrolment.student_index(data.students, student_id)
            if student < 0
                lines = lines.append("STUDENT {student_id} not found")
                continue
            StudentResult result := student_result(student)
            int[] courses := data.students[student].courses
            lines = lines.append("STUDENT {student_id} exams {#courses} scheduled {#result.assigned} penalty {result.penalty}")
            for course := result.assigned[]
                placement := placements[course]
                offset := 0
                for enrolled := data.courses[course].students[]
                    if enrolled == student_id
                        break
                    offset += 1
                seat := placement.first + offset
                lines = lines.append("  {calendar.name(assignment[course])} {id(course)} room {available[placement.room].id} seat {seat} {data.courses[course].name}")
            for course := courses[]
                if assignment[course] == 0
                    lines = lines.append("  UNSCHEDULED {id(course)} {data.courses[course].name}")
            for: i < int(#result.assigned)
                a := result.assigned[i]
                for: i + 1 <= j < int(#result.assigned)
                    b := result.assigned[j]
                    relation := calendar.relation(assignment[a], assignment[b])
                    if relation >= 0
                        lines = lines.append("  {relations[relation]} {calendar.name(assignment[a])} {id(a)} {calendar.name(assignment[b])} {id(b)}")
            for: 1 <= slot <= calendar.slots
                if calendar.blocked(student, slot)
                    lines = lines.append("  UNAVAILABLE {calendar.name(slot)}")
        return lines

    string[] status_lines()
        lines := ["course,status,slot,students,minutes,degree,penalty"]
        int[] values := contributions()
        for: int c < graph.count
            status := "no_slot"
            if context.fixed[c] > 0
                status = "fixed"
            elif assignment[c] > 0
                status = "scheduled"
            elif enrolment.has_int(oversized, c)
                status = "too_large"
            elif size(c) == 0
                status = "empty"
            slot := if assignment[c] > 0 then calendar.name(assignment[c]) else "-"
            lines = lines.append("{id(c)},{status},{slot},{size(c)},{data.courses[c].duration},{graph.degrees[c]},{values[c]}")
        return lines

    string[] graph_lines()
        edges := 0
        shared := 0
        for a := graph.vertices[]
            for b := graph.vertices[]
                if a < b and graph.strength(a, b) > 0
                    edges += 1
                    shared += graph.strength(a, b)
        vertices := int(#graph.vertices)
        density := if vertices >= 2 then 2000 * edges / (vertices * (vertices - 1)) else 0
        lines := ["GRAPH courses {vertices} edges {edges} shared {shared} density {density}"]
        int[] ranked_vertices := graph.by_degree(graph.vertices)
        for: i < smaller(5, int(#ranked_vertices))
            course := ranked_vertices[i]
            lines = lines.append("DEGREE {id(course)} neighbours {graph.degrees[course]} shared {graph.shared_total(course)} students {size(course)}")
        int[][] components := graph.components()
        lines = lines.append("COMPONENTS {#components}")
        for: i < int(#components)
            component := components[i]
            lines = lines.append("COMPONENT {i + 1} size {#component} first {id(component[0])}")
        int[] clique := graph.clique(schedulable)
        fields := ["CLIQUE", "size", "{#clique}"]
        for course := clique[]
            fields = fields.append(id(course))
        return lines.append(fields.join(" "))

    string[] capacity_lines()
        maximum := 0
        attaining := 0
        for student := data.students[]
            load := int(#student.courses)
            if load > maximum
                maximum = load
                attaining = 0
            if load == maximum
                attaining += 1
        demand := 0
        for course := schedulable[]
            demand += size(course)
        capacity := 0
        for room := available[]
            capacity += room.capacity
        degree_slots := coloring.greedy_numbering(graph.by_degree(schedulable), graph)
        size_slots := coloring.greedy_numbering(rooms.by_size(data.courses, schedulable), graph)
        lines := ["LOAD max_exams {maximum} students {attaining}", "SEATS demand {demand} capacity {capacity} min_slots {ceil_div(demand, capacity)}", "HEURISTIC largest_degree slots {degree_slots}", "HEURISTIC largest_enrolment slots {size_slots}"]
        table := rooms.by_size(data.courses, graph.vertices)
        table = table[0:<smaller(8, int(#table))]
        string[] header := []
        for course := table[]
            header = header.append(id(course))
        lines = lines.append(report.fixed_width_line("MATRIX", header, 9, 9))
        for row := table[]
            string[] cells := []
            for column := table[]
                cells = cells.append(if row == column then "-" else "{graph.strength(row, column)}")
            lines = lines.append(report.fixed_width_line(id(row), cells, 9, 9))
        return lines

    string[] report_lines()
        lines := ["INPUT courses {graph.count} enrolments {data.accepted} rooms {#available} students {#data.students} errors {#data.errors}"]
        for message := data.errors[]
            lines = lines.append("ERROR {message}")
        lines = lines.concat(graph_lines()).concat(capacity_lines())
        for course := empty[]
            lines = lines.append("EMPTY {id(course)}")
        for course := oversized[]
            lines = lines.append("TOO_LARGE {id(course)} students {size(course)} largest_room {largest_room}")
        for: 1 <= slot <= calendar.slots
            if calendar.closed[slot]
                lines = lines.append("CLOSED {calendar.name(slot)}")
        for: int c < graph.count
            if context.fixed[c] > 0
                lines = lines.append("FIXED {id(c)} {calendar.name(context.fixed[c])}")
        for order := context.orders[]
            lines = lines.append("AFTER {id(order.later)} {id(order.earlier)}")
        for: i < int(#attempts)
            attempt := attempts[i]
            result := if attempt.failed < 0 then "success" else "failed {id(attempt.failed)}"
            lines = lines.append("ATTEMPT {i + 1} courses {attempt.count} backtracks {attempt.dead_ends} {result}")
        for: i < int(#assignment_order)
            record := assignment_order[i]
            lines = lines.append("ORDER {i + 1} {id(record.course)} {calendar.name(record.slot)} saturation {record.saturation} degree {graph.degrees[record.course]}")
        for insertion := insertions[]
            lines = lines.append("INSERTED {id(insertion.course)} {calendar.name(insertion.slot)} penalty {insertion.increase}")
        for course := unscheduled()[]
            too_large := enrolment.has_int(oversized, course)
            reason := if too_large then "too_large" else "no_slot"
            lines = lines.append("UNSCHEDULED {id(course)} reason {reason} students {size(course)}")
            if not too_large
                for: 1 <= slot <= calendar.slots
                    lines = lines.append("  {calendar.name(slot)} {reasons[course][slot - 1]}")
        slots_used := 0
        for slot := context.open[]
            if #context.at_slot(assignment, slot) > 0
                slots_used += 1
        lines = lines.append("SUMMARY scheduled {#assigned_courses()} unscheduled {#unscheduled()} slots_used {slots_used} penalty {penalty}")
        return lines

string spaces(int count)
    return " " * nat(count)

string fixed_width_line(string label, string[] cells, int label_width, int cell_width)
    result := label + spaces(label_width - int(#label))
    for cell := cells[]
        result += spaces(cell_width - int(#cell)) + cell
    return result

int rounded_percent(int part, int whole)
    return (200 * part + whole) / (2 * whole)

void prepare()
    if not file.exists("output")
        file.mkdir("output")

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

import collections
import enrolment = "./enrolment.qui"

class Room(string id, int capacity)
class Placement(int course, int room, int first, int last)
class Packing(bool success, Placement[] placements)

Room[] load(string[] &errors)
    Room[] result := []
    lines := enrolment.read_lines("input/rooms.csv")
    for: 1 <= i < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[i].split(",")
        id := fields[0]
        capacity := int(fields[1])
        duplicate := false
        for room := result[]
            if room.id == id
                duplicate = true
        if duplicate
            errors = errors.append("rooms.csv line {i + 1}: duplicate room {id}")
        elif capacity < 1
            errors = errors.append("rooms.csv line {i + 1}: bad capacity {capacity}")
        else
            position := int(#result)
            result = result.append(Room(id, capacity))
            while position > 0
                previous := result[position - 1]
                if previous.capacity < capacity or (previous.capacity == capacity and collections.lex_compare(previous.id.codepoints(), id.codepoints()) < 0)
                    break
                result[position] = previous
                position -= 1
            result[position] = Room(id, capacity)
    return result

int[] by_size(enrolment.Course[] courses, int[] selected)
    int[] result := []
    for c := selected[]
        position := int(#result)
        result = result.append(c)
        while position > 0
            previous := result[position - 1]
            if #courses[previous].students > #courses[c].students or (#courses[previous].students == #courses[c].students and previous < c)
                break
            result[position] = previous
            position -= 1
        result[position] = c
    return result

Packing pack(Room[] available, enrolment.Course[] courses, int[] selected)
    int[] remaining := []
    for room := available[]
        remaining = remaining.append(room.capacity)
    durations := array(#available, fill = 0)
    Placement[] placements := []
    for c := by_size(courses, selected)[]
        count := int(#courses[c].students)
        placed := false
        for: r < int(#available)
            if remaining[r] >= count and (durations[r] == 0 or durations[r] == courses[c].duration)
                first := available[r].capacity - remaining[r] + 1
                placements = placements.append(Placement(c, r, first, first + count - 1))
                remaining[r] -= count
                durations[r] = courses[c].duration
                placed = true
                break
        if not placed
            return Packing(false, [])
    return Packing(true, placements)
